features.feature: RED test reproduces an unbounded repeat-block loop against a phase gate driven with an identical block reason, proving no repeat-block detection exists today
Repeat-block ledger keyed on (storyId, gate, digest of block reason); increments on identical consecutive block, resets when the gate passes or the reason changes
Digest key is widened via structured signal extraction (bracketed reason codes + diagnostic gap ids) so genuinely different blockers sharing an invariant prefix get different keys
Bracketed reason-code signal must contain at least one underscore, so ordinary bracketed annotations ([note]/[info]/[todo]) do not count as signals and cannot mint a fresh key per attempt (F-002 fix)
Digest basis structurally encodes prefix+signals (JSON) instead of a literal " signals:" string delimiter, making the key boundary structural/key-neutral (F-003 fix)
Breaker hard-stops once the counter reaches the trip threshold on a genuinely repeated blocker
On trip, the diagnostic names the actual unmet precondition rather than emitting a generic refusal
Tripping the breaker never marks the gate satisfied
Tripping the breaker never rewrites finding/review attribution
Tripping the breaker never advances the story phase
Reasons carrying no structured signal keep their historical prefix-only key (back-compat; no regression to the existing convergence-breaker-smoke)
Smoke covers fire: breaker trips at threshold on identical repeated blocks
Smoke covers no-fire: breaker does not trip when the block reason changes between attempts
Smoke covers reset: counter resets after the gate passes
The smoke is registered in the validate command set (lattice.config.json)
